 The Retail Analytics team supports CVS Health’s Front Store business by delivering data\-driven business product that improve consumer experience a ess performance. **Role Overview**
 As a Software Development Engineer on the Retail Analytics team, you will be primarily responsible for designing and building the data foundation that powers our analytics platform. This means owning the end\-to\-end data layer in Snowflake — fact tables, dimension tables, and aggregate metrics tables — and building the ThoughtSpot data models and TML (ThoughtSpot Modeling Language) that expose that data to business users. You will also contribute to the React/TypeScript front\-end layer, embedding ThoughtSpot analytics experiences into our internal applications.
   

  

 This is an individual contributor role with opportunity to grow technical scope and platform ownership over time.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and build Snowflake fact, dimension, and aggregate metrics tables that support retail analytics use cases including pricing, assortment, promotions, and category management
* Develop and maintain ThoughtSpot data models — Worksheets, Views, and TML definitions — to expose curated, governed data layers to business users
* Write and optimize complex SQL in Snowflake including window functions, CTEs, incremental loading patterns, and query performance tuning
* Define and enforce data modeling standards, naming conventions, metric definitions, and documentation practices across the analytics data layer
* Integrate ThoughtSpot analytics experiences (liveboards, search, visualizations) into internal applications using the ThoughtSpot Everywhere SDK with React and TypeScript
* Build and maintain React/TypeScript components that wrap and extend ThoughtSpot embedded experiences, connecting them to Snowflake\-backed APIs and data models
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including PMs, Data Engineering, and business stakeholders, to identify business needs and translate them into requirements for solution improvements or ad hoc analyses in a fast\-paced environment.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience
* 2\+ years of SQL development — strong command of complex queries, joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization in a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred)
* Demonstrated experience designing dimensional data models — facts, dimensions, and aggregate/summary tables
* Experience building or maintaining BI semantic layers, data models, or governed metrics definitions (ThoughtSpot, dbt, Looker, or equivalent)
* 1\+ years of React and TypeScript development — able to build and maintain front\-end components and integrate third\-party SDKs
* Experience with cloud\-based platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS)
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with analysts, product managers, and business stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Direct experience with ThoughtSpot — Worksheets, Liveboards, TML, and the ThoughtSpot Everywhere SDK
* Experience with Snowflake\-specific features: clustering keys, materialized views, dynamic tables, and cost governance
* Familiarity with retail merchandising domain concepts (pricing, assortment, promotions, category management)
* Experience working in an agile/scrum environment

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Software Engineer who builds and operates the AI\-native backend systems powering our go\-to\-market motion. You'll design multi\-agent architectures, build reliable integrations across complex business systems, and own services end\-to\-end from prototype through production.
   

  

 The systems you build orchestrate LLM\-powered agents that handle real business workflows — qualifying leads, generating emails, routing meetings, enriching contacts, and managing outbound campaigns. These are stateful, multi\-step agent systems running on Kubernetes that make decisions, call tools, and interact with external APIs under real constraints: rate limits, token budgets, cost targets, and data quality issues.
   

  

 You'll partner with Engineering Leads and Technical Product Managers to understand the problem space, then translate those problems into well\-architected, observable, and maintainable software. This isn't prompt engineering and it isn't gluing together SaaS tools \- it's systems engineering with AI as a core primitive.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on builder role with high ownership. You'll make architectural decisions, ship iteratively, debug production issues, and care deeply about what happens after code merges.

* Architect model\-agnostic abstraction layers that decouple business logic from LLM providers, enabling flexibility across Claude, GPT, and open\-source models
* Build and operate backend services (FastAPI/Flask) deployed on Kubernetes with CI/CD, managing the full lifecycle from deployment configuration to production reliability
* Design tool\-use patterns for AI agents \- structured function calling, multi\-step reasoning, state management across conversation turns, and graceful handling of model failures
* Build integrations across external systems (CRM, enrichment APIs, outreach platforms, Slack) with proper error handling, retries, rate limiting, and data contracts
* Instrument and monitor AI systems in production — build observability into agent behavior, track success rates, detect regressions, and debug non\-deterministic failures

* Experience testing and evaluating non\-deterministic AI systems — you understand that assert output \=\= expected doesn't work and have built or used alternatives

* Proficiency with SQL and data systems for building targeting, enrichment, and analytics pipelines
* Built observability into production systems — structured logging, tracing, alerting, and monitoring that you actually use to debug issues
* High ownership: you deploy your own code, investigate your own incidents, and close the loop between what you shipped and how it performs

**About Zip**
 Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.
   

  

 The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T\-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.
   

  

 Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2\.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.
   

  

**Your role**
 You'll join Zip's Forward Deployed Software Engineering team as a software engineer on some of the highest\-impact product work at the company. You'll write and ship production code, partner directly with our most critical customers, and own the engineering on the deals that matter most to Zip.
   

  

 The team operates close to the customer, moves with urgency, and builds the features that determine whether the biggest deals close on time, whether our most demanding customers stay on the leading edge of the product, and what enterprise\-grade looks like in our platform.
   

  

 If you've done Forward Deployed work elsewhere, this is a place to keep doing it \- on real product, at scale, for some of the most recognizable companies in the world.
   

  

**You will**
* Lead the engineering on critical customer projects. You'll own scope, sequencing, and delivery against the timelines that high\-stakes deals demand, embedded in the implementation cadence alongside our Field PM and Solutions Consultants.
* Ship high\-impact features that move the most important strategic deals and renewals forward. The work this team takes on is what makes the platform enterprise\-grade \- net\-new product capabilities, framework gaps (APIs, exports, notifications, etc), and targeted enhancements that ship in days or weeks.
* Bring strong product sense to every decision. Partner with core product teams to decide what to build, what to push back on, and what to redirect. Strong opinions are welcome; strong opinions grounded in what you heard on a customer call are gold.
* Shape Zip's long\-term platform and roadmap. Features you ship land at our most critical customers first and compound into the platform, and the patterns you see first become next year's product investments.
* Communicate directly with customers. You'll be on calls with procurement, finance, and IT teams, diagnose problems live against real deadlines, and translate trade\-offs in language that lands with both engineers and executives.


**Your Qualifications**
* Strong software engineering skills. You've shipped non\-trivial production systems and you can read and write code across the stack: Python on the backend and React/TypeScript on the frontend at Zip.
* Product instincts and judgment. You're the engineer on your current team who pushes back on poorly scoped requirements, who notices when a feature is solving the wrong problem, and who's willing to say so.
* Customer empathy and crisp communication. You can sit in a room with a Director of Procurement at a $50B company, hear what they're actually worried about, and translate it into a tech spec, and vice versa. If you've never done this before but the idea sounds energizing, that counts.
* Speed and urgency with a high quality bar. You can move on a customer\-driven timeline and still write code that holds up in production.

 Founded in 2023, Tensec is a global fintech that enables small and medium\-sized businesses (SMBs) to enter global trade and thrive by giving them access to global transaction banking solutions that are user\-friendly, efficient, and secure.
   

  

 Tensec founders have driven startups from foundation to exit, built decacorns, and led global teams at companies such as PayPal, Credit Karma, Facebook, Goldman Sachs, Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. We’re putting together a world\-class team to disrupt the $50 trillion cross\-border b2b financial services industry by providing SMBs the financial strength to participate and win in the global economy.
   

  

 We believe that successful companies and teams are directly correlated to a company's cultural DNA. At Tensec, we make a deliberate effort to create values and foster a culture able to unleash both human and organizational potential. We strongly believe that the best business results derive from teams that have a strong identification with a mission, push themselves to the edge, and love what they do.
   

  

 The Tensec team is diverse and global, with members in San Francisco, New York, Miami, Monterrey, and Sao Paulo.  We move fast, debrief quickly, and expect you to own your output. This is a dynamic company, we value speed and decisiveness over process. You'll have the context you need to make good decisions, and the autonomy to make them.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Tensec is looking for an experienced Software Engineer to design and ship the products our customers actually touch. Dealing with transactions and compliance across borders adds a level of complexity most industries never face — and we believe smarter infrastructure and thoughtful design can change that. Here are some of the challenges you could help us tackle:
   

  

* Reimagine cross\-border compliance \& operations: automate painful manual processes and make teams far more productive
* Build AI applications for cross\-border financial services: develop intelligent systems that enhance transaction processing, risk assessment, and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions
* Enable trading \& finance for SMBs: give smaller businesses access to financial tools once reserved for large institutions, utilizing stablecoins to facilitate global market access and liquidity
* Simplify complex global workflows: design user experiences that bring transparency to payments spanning multiple countries and currencies
* Build resilient technical foundations: support diverse payment rails worldwide, reconcile across currencies and financial institutions, and ensure security at a global scale
* Level up the team: introduce new technologies and practices that improve how we build and operate together


 As a software engineer, you would expect to:
   

  

* Own features end to end — from discovery and design through development, launch, and iteration.
* Build across the stack: responsive, intuitive frontends and the secure, reliable backends and infrastructure behind them.
* Partner closely with product, design, and cross\-functional teams to translate vision into shipped product.
* Prototype quickly to validate ideas, then harden the winners into scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Write clean, reliable, well\-tested, well\-documented code, and define best practices for development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Proactively monitor, identify, and resolve production issues to keep the experience fast, secure, and reliable.
* Stay on top of where the industry is heading — and bring new tools, patterns, and ideas back to make our systems better.
* Work effectively with people across time zones and regions.


 To thrive in this role, you have:
   

  

* 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with hands\-on full\-stack delivery — modern frontend frameworks plus API development and database design.
* A track record of shipping products to real end users and iterating based on their feedback.
* Proven experience with popular frameworks; React and Node.js (or comparable) a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with modern cloud platforms, CI/CD, and monitoring tools.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) — and enthusiasm for using them to ship faster and better.
* A stack\-agnostic mindset and the versatility to quickly learn and adapt.
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills, strong product instincts, and an entrepreneurial spirit.
* Deep empathy for customers and a fervent passion for elevating user experience.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact with a diverse team and stakeholders.
* Experience in — or strong desire to work in — early\-stage startup environments.
* Prior fintech industry experience.
